_doc: Ground-truth oracle for the Jill vendor PhysioPS document, page 2 (the scanned per-phase numeric grid supplied by the operator and transcribed verbatim). This is the ONLY numeric per-phase LFa/RFa/SB grid available anywhere in this repo's fixtures, so it is the reference used to QUANTIFY the error of the HumanOS waveform estimates. It is a COMPARISON TARGET ONLY: nothing in the engine may be fitted, tuned, calibrated, scaled or special-cased toward these numbers, and no code path may read this file at runtime. do_not_load_at_runtime.
_provenance: Transcribed by hand from the supplied scanned PhysioPS page 2 for the de-identified Jill study (fixture jill_deid.ans). Values are exactly as printed; no rounding, derivation or interpolation was applied.

protocolPhases._doc: Vendor per-phase grid. duration mm:ss as printed. meanHR bpm, rangeHR bpm, FRF Hz, LFa/RFa bpm^2, ratio = LFa/RFa (sympathovagal balance) as printed by the vendor.

timeDomainRatios._doc: Ewing time-domain ratios as printed on the same vendor page.

engineContract._doc: What THIS engine must and must not do with the Jill inputs.

fromAnsAlone.note: The raw .ans yields Ewing ratios, identity and the waveform. Waveform-derived LFa/RFa/SB are published as labelled HumanOS estimates with computed/estimated provenance; spectralAvailable stays false so nothing clinical consumes them.

mustNever: fit, scale, tune or calibrate any engine constant toward these vendor numbers
claim parity with, or validation against, these vendor numbers
read this oracle at runtime or key any behaviour on this patient, this filename or this study date
publish waveform-derived LFa/RFa/SB as vendor-reported, PhysioPS-validated, or clinically interpretable values
mustAlways: report the signed error and relative error of every estimate against the paired vendor value
state that the comparison is a measurement of disagreement, not a calibration
